identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][state] Unify durable kernel state on redb

values.task_boundary: Runtime v3 durable local state only; no Provider/ACIP/A2A/Cloud Bridge transport behavior, no Runtime v2 deletion, and no WP-12 launch harness changes beyond preserving compatibility.
deliverables: restart, corruption, identity, and writer-lock tests
strict Clippy and diff hygiene proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A real Runtime v3 process stores checkpoint state through redb, restarts, and restores the exact persisted bytes and generation.
AC-2: Lifelog append uses the same redb database and a documented atomic transaction boundary.
AC-3: Principal, runtime identity, schema, generation, and hash mismatches fail closed.
AC-4: A second live writer for the same state root is rejected without corrupting the first writer.
AC-5: Crash/restart and interrupted-write tests recover from the last committed transaction only.
AC-6: Corrupt or unsupported database/schema state returns an explicit fatal error and never falls back to JSON/JSONL files.
AC-7: The old production checkpoint.json and lifelog.jsonl paths are deleted or restricted to non-production migration tests after parity proof.
AC-8: Focused macOS/Linux/native-Windows-capable tests use real filesystem state and do not use fixtures, wrappers, nested builds, or /private/tmp.
AC-9: One exact pre-PR review confirms one durable state authority and no hidden flat-file fallback.
dependencies: WP-12 #5344 exact head ca242a5a for current Runtime v3 launch simplification
redb COTS crate already used by adl-runtime backpressure
Runtime v3 local adapter execution surface
